purpose: Curated, no-Codex backfill of app-launch preparation lists from existing synthesis evidence.

lists.title: 20-point app pre-launch checklist
lists.summary: The creator’s complete pre-launch sequence for testing, observability, compliance, cost control, recovery, payments and release timing.

items.label: Run a real beta
items.description: Test the app with real users before public release.
items.resource_name: Google Play testing and staged rollout

items.label: Wire up crash reporting
items.description: Capture crashes and exceptions before launch.

items.label: Build account deletion
items.description: Provide a user-accessible account-deletion path.

items.label: Host the privacy policy
items.description: Publish the privacy notice before review and release.

items.label: Declare what SDKs collect
items.description: Make platform privacy disclosures match actual SDK behaviour.

items.label: Configure SPF, DKIM and DMARC
items.description: Authenticate the app’s email domain.

items.label: Test signup with a fresh Gmail account
items.description: Verify onboarding outside the developer’s existing account state.

items.label: Set hard spend caps on every API
items.description: Bound third-party API cost exposure.

items.label: Monitor LLM credit balances
items.description: Track paid model usage before balances interrupt production.

items.label: Move off a pausing free tier
items.description: Use infrastructure that will not unexpectedly pause the production app.

items.label: Rehearse a database restore
items.description: Prove that backups can actually restore service.

items.label: Ship a kill switch
items.description: Provide an emergency control for unsafe or costly functionality.

items.label: Provide an over-the-air hotfix path
items.description: Prepare a bounded way to deliver urgent fixes.

items.label: Move support email to your own domain
items.description: Use a domain-controlled support channel.

items.label: Use an agent or business address, not your home
items.description: Avoid exposing a personal home address in reviewer or business contact details.

items.label: Put a demo account in review notes
items.description: Give app reviewers working access and instructions.

items.label: Test restore purchases after reinstall
items.description: Verify entitlement recovery in a clean install.

items.label: Swap test payment credentials for production
items.description: Confirm production billing configuration before release.

items.label: Turn on phased release
items.description: Roll out gradually so faults can be detected before full distribution.

items.label: Do not submit on a Friday
items.description: The creator recommends avoiding release timing with limited support coverage.

lists.title: Niche security checks for a vibe-coded app
lists.summary: Ten specific production-security checks covering data access, deployment integrity, webhooks, identifiers, logs and privileged access.

items.label: Review SECURITY DEFINER functions against RLS
items.description: Ensure privileged database functions do not bypass intended row-level policies.
items.resource_name: Row-level security and SECURITY DEFINER review

items.label: Keep logged-in pages out of shared CDN caches
items.description: Prevent personalised content from being served across users.

items.label: Remove dangling DNS records
items.description: Delete records pointing to decommissioned services.

items.label: Pin GitHub Actions to full commit hashes
items.description: Avoid mutable action tags in CI/CD workflows.

items.label: Reject stale webhook timestamps
items.description: Combine signature checks with replay protection.

items.label: Keep production source maps private
items.description: Retain debugging value without publicly exposing source mappings.

items.label: Add integrity hashes to third-party scripts
items.description: Use Subresource Integrity for externally hosted assets.

items.label: Use opaque identifiers
items.description: Prefer UUIDs while still enforcing object-level authorisation.

items.label: Scrub tokens and passwords from logs
items.description: Exclude or redact credentials and secrets.

items.label: Put the admin panel behind MFA
items.description: Require multiple factors for privileged access.

lists.title: 20 application-security checks before launch
lists.summary: The Reel’s complete pre-launch application-security checklist, preserved in spoken order.

items.label: Hide privileged API keys
items.description: Keep secret and privileged keys out of client code.

items.label: Purge committed secrets
items.description: Remove exposed credentials and rotate them when necessary.

items.label: Use only deliberately public database keys in clients
items.description: Public keys must be scoped and backed by server-side policy.

items.label: Enable row-level security
items.description: Apply explicit database policies to exposed tables.

items.label: Encrypt sensitive data
items.description: Protect sensitive information in storage and transit.

items.label: Enforce server-side authentication
items.description: Do not rely on interface visibility as an access boundary.

items.label: Lock record access
items.description: Enforce per-user and per-tenant authorisation.

items.label: Block field tampering
items.description: Allow only intended fields and values to be changed.

items.label: Secure session cookies
items.description: Use secure cookie attributes and session controls.

items.label: Hash passwords
items.description: Store passwords using an appropriate password-hashing design.

items.label: Rate-limit login
items.description: Bound repeated authentication attempts.

items.label: Add bot protection
items.description: Detect and limit automated abuse where appropriate.

items.label: Parameterise database queries
items.description: Keep untrusted input out of executable query structure.

items.label: Validate every input
items.description: Apply allowlisted, context-aware input validation.

items.label: Escape user-controlled content
items.description: Encode output for its rendering context.

items.label: Restrict file uploads
items.description: Validate, isolate and safely serve uploaded files.

items.label: Trim API responses
items.description: Return only data the caller needs and may access.

items.label: Add security headers
items.description: Apply browser security controls appropriate to the app.

items.label: Force HTTPS
items.description: Protect network traffic with TLS.

items.label: Scan dependencies
items.description: Check third-party packages for known vulnerabilities.

lists.title: 18 security risks to check in an AI-built app
lists.summary: Eighteen application-security risks spanning browser attacks, authentication, APIs, payments, logging and production exposure.

items.label: Cross-site scripting
items.description: Test untrusted content handling and contextual output encoding.

items.label: Cross-site request forgery
items.description: Protect state-changing browser requests.

items.label: Insecure file uploads
items.description: Validate and isolate user-uploaded content.

items.label: Path traversal
items.description: Prevent file paths from escaping authorised roots.

items.label: Server-side request forgery
items.description: Restrict server-side network requests influenced by users.

items.label: Broken password-reset flows
items.description: Review reset tokens, enumeration and recovery behaviour.
items.resource_name: OWASP Authentication and Session Management Cheat Sheets

items.label: Weak session management
items.description: Harden session creation, storage, rotation and expiry.
items.resource_name: OWASP Authentication and Session Management Cheat Sheets

items.label: Weak JWT secrets
items.description: Use safe signing, verification and key management.

items.label: Overly permissive CORS
items.description: Allow only intended cross-origin access.

items.label: Missing rate limits
items.description: Bound resource consumption and repeated abuse.

items.label: Exposed test or staging environments
items.description: Keep non-production services and credentials inaccessible.

items.label: Default credentials left unchanged
items.description: Remove or replace vendor and development defaults.

items.label: Unsigned webhooks
items.description: Verify provider signatures on webhook payloads.

items.label: Payment checks only on the front end
items.description: Verify purchases and entitlements server-side.

items.label: IDOR and BOLA
items.description: Enforce object-level authorisation on every request.

items.label: APIs trusting user-controlled input
items.description: Validate and authorise all client-supplied values.

items.label: Sensitive data in logs
items.description: Exclude secrets and private data from operational logs.

items.label: Exposed production source maps
items.description: Review whether source maps are publicly reachable.

lists.title: Advanced security checks for AI-built apps
lists.summary: The Reel’s numbered advanced checklist for identity, workflows, CI/CD, AI features and real-time interfaces.

items.label: Add MFA
items.description: Protect sensitive and administrative accounts with multiple factors.

items.label: Prevent account enumeration
items.description: Avoid revealing whether an account exists through login or recovery flows.

items.label: Test business-logic abuse
items.description: Look beyond input validation to workflow and economic abuse.

items.label: Test race conditions in critical operations
items.description: Make concurrent state changes safe and idempotent.
items.resource_name: OWASP Secure Coding Practices - Quick Reference Guide

items.label: Reject webhook replays
items.description: Verify freshness and idempotency as well as signatures.

items.label: Restrict CI/CD permissions and deployment credentials
items.description: Use least privilege in automation and deployment.

items.label: Review third-party GitHub Actions
items.description: Treat external workflow code as a supply-chain dependency.

items.label: Pin and review build dependencies
items.description: Detect vulnerable or unexpected dependency changes.

items.label: Make security checks fail closed
items.description: Do not continue sensitive operations when validation fails.
items.resource_name: OWASP Secure Coding Practices - Quick Reference Guide

items.label: Set timeouts
items.description: Bound external calls and long-running operations.
items.resource_name: OWASP Secure Coding Practices - Quick Reference Guide

items.label: Stop AI features leaking sensitive information
items.description: Control data supplied to and returned by models.
items.resource_name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

items.label: Safely handle AI-generated output
items.description: Treat model output as untrusted data.
items.resource_name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

items.label: Limit AI-agent permissions
items.description: Give agents only the tools and data needed for their task.
items.resource_name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

items.label: Keep sensitive data out of local storage
items.description: Use appropriate session and storage controls.

items.label: Block open redirects
items.description: Restrict user-controlled redirect destinations.
items.resource_name: OWASP Unvalidated Redirects and Forwards Cheat Sheet

items.label: Secure GraphQL
items.description: Apply limits, authorisation and trusted-query controls.

items.label: Secure WebSocket and real-time endpoints
items.description: Authenticate, authorise and validate real-time messages.

items.label: Detect malicious packages

items.label: Defend against prompt injection

items.label: Prevent unpermissioned AI access

items.label: Reduce excessive database permissions
items.description: Apply least privilege to data access.

items.label: Add audit logs

items.label: Add security monitoring
items.description: Detect and respond to anomalous security events.

items.label: Test backups and recovery
items.description: Ensure production data can be restored.

items.label: Protect internal dashboards
items.description: Keep administrative interfaces private and authorised.

items.label: Add security headers
items.description: Configure browser-facing defensive headers.

items.label: Harden cookie settings
items.description: Use secure cookie and session attributes.

items.label: Encrypt sensitive data
items.description: Protect sensitive stored and transmitted information.

items.label: Enforce tenant isolation
items.description: Prevent data access across tenants.

items.label: Review AI-generated code
items.description: Apply human security review to generated changes.

items.label: Prevent mass assignment

items.label: Prevent command injection

items.label: Harden OAuth configuration
items.description: Follow current OAuth security best practices.

lists.title: 10 legal and compliance checks for a quickly built app

items.label: Publish a privacy policy
items.description: Document actual data practices before release.

items.label: Disclose collection of user data
items.description: Make privacy disclosures match actual collection.

items.label: Disclose use of AI
items.description: Avoid misleading users about AI-enabled functionality.

items.label: Name third parties receiving data
items.description: Disclose relevant processors and recipients where required.

items.label: Actually delete uploads when promised
items.description: Make retention behaviour match user-facing promises.

items.label: Keep storage buckets private by default
items.description: Enforce explicit storage access policies.

items.label: Do not use fake testimonials
items.description: Use authentic, properly disclosed reviews.

items.label: Make subscription cancellation straightforward
items.description: Avoid obstructive negative-option cancellation flows.

items.label: Warn before a free trial auto-charges
items.description: Make renewal and charging terms clear.

items.label: Add a self-harm response for AI chatbots
items.description: Provide safe handling for high-risk distress content.

lists.title: Four legal risk mitigations before app launch
lists.summary: Four legal/compliance measures from the Reel, with its categorical penalty claims treated as unverified rather than universal law.

items.label: Review terms and dispute-resolution provisions

items.label: Complete Apple and Google privacy disclosures accurately
